title: Writing to Bob Lazar about his experience

tellings.quote: when I when I wrote uh Bob Salazar. I'm not in this for anything.

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was taken by aliens, says he wrote to Bob Lazar, a man known for claiming he worked on alien craft for the government, about what happened to him. Barth tells Michels that in his letter he said, "I'm not in this for anything", meaning he wanted no money or fame from it.
